paper_title: AI Scientists Fail Without Strong Implementation Capability
caption: Analysis of AI Scientist publications on arXiv. The upper panel displays the average number of citations up to now, categorized by containing implementation details. The lower panel shows the growth in the total number of these papers with the same categorization.
model_annotation: The plot displays the growth in the total number of AI scientist publications on arXiv over time, categorized by whether they include implementation details. The x-axis represents time, labeled with three discrete seasons: "Fall '24", "Winter '24", and "Spring '25", arranged linearly from left to right. The y-axis, labeled "Quantity", is scaled linearly from 0 to 24, with tick marks at intervals of 3, and represents the total number of papers. Two lines are shown: a teal line with circular markers labeled "Without Implementation" and an orange line with square markers labeled "With Implementation". The teal line starts at a value of 10 in Fall '24, increases to 15 in Winter '24, and reaches 21 in Spring '25, indicating a steady upward trend. The orange line starts at 2 in Fall '24, rises to 7 in Winter '24, and reaches 13 in Spring '25, also showing a consistent increase. The area under each line is shaded—light teal for "Without Implementation" and light orange for "With Implementation"—to visually emphasize the cumulative quantity over time.
